_method: SimpleQA-style 3-way grading (Wei et al. 2024): correct / incorrect / not_attempted, applied by rules then audited by hand (2026-09-18) over every distinct answer to a live-data case. 'correct' means specific and faithful to the tool result that turn; ground truth is the tool output, cross-checked for consistency across runs (e.g. every match_result call returned Elche 2-3 Real Madrid), not an independent world lookup. Answers with no retrieval that decline or ask for context are not_attempted. Condition D emits a call and never answers, so it is not graded on this axis. Keys: case_id -> answer prefix -> label.

_notes.news-current E/e2b: graded incorrect: a generic, undated claim that does not answer 'this month' although search results were retrieved
_notes.football-result E-think/e2b: the tool said Elche 2-3 Real Madrid; the answer inverts the outcome
